title: Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain Revives the 3DS Adventure on Switch 2 With Enhanced Graphics and New Content
description: Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 with enhanced graphics, new story content and new Yo-kai. No release date has been announced.
image_alt: Nate walks through a Japanese street with a Yo-kai companion in Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain promotional imagery.
quick_read: Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain is coming to Nintendo Switch 2.
Nintendo describes it as an evolution of Bony Spirits, Fleshy Souls and Psychic Specters with enhanced graphics and new content.
LEVEL-5 says additional story content, new features and new Yo-kai are in development.
No release date has been announced yet.

content_blocks.heading: Yo-kai Watch 2 is getting another life
New story content is part of the package
More Yo-kai are joining Nate's return
Springdale returns to a very different Nintendo era
The biggest mystery is the release date
A revival with more still hiding in the shadows
